from model import QModel
import numpy as np

class Agent(object):
    def __init__(self, agentNum, IL, AO, AS, c_h, c_p, eta, compuType, config):
        
        self.agentNum = agentNum
        self.IL = IL		# Inventory level of each agent - changes during the game
        self.OO =  [0 for i in range(config.noItems)]	# Open order of each agent - changes during the game
        self.ASInitial = AS # the initial arriving shipment.
        self.ILInitial = IL	# IL at which we start each game with this number
        self.AOInitial = AO	# OO at which we start each game with this number
        self.config = config	# an instance of config is stored inside the class
        self.currentState = []  # this function gets the current state of the game
        self.nextState = []
        self.currentReward = 0 	# the reward observed at the current step
        self.currentCost = 0 # cost of backorders and overstocking
        self.rewardArray = [[0 for i in range(self.config.noItems)]]
        self.costArray = [[0 for i in range(self.config.noItems)]]
        self.cumulativeRewardRealtime = 0
        self.totalReward = 0    	# it is reward of all players obtained for the current player.
        self.holdingCost=c_h		# holding cost
        self.shortageCost = c_p		# backorder cost
        self.eta = eta		# the total cost regulazer
        self.AS = AS 	# arrived shipment 
        self.AO = AO	# arrived order
        self.action = [0 for item in range(self.config.noItems)]		# the action at time t
        self.compTypeTrain = compuType # rnd -> random / srdqn-> srdqn / Strm-> formula-Rong2008 / bs -> optimal policy if exists
        self.compTypeTest = compuType # rnd -> random / srdqn-> srdqn / Strm-> formula-Rong2008 / bs -> optimal policy if exists
        self.alpha_p = self.config.alpha_p[self.agentNum] # parameters for the formula
        self.beta_p = self.config.beta_p[self.agentNum] # parameters for the formula
        if self.config.demandDistribution == 0:
            self.a_b = np.mean((self.config.demandUpperLimit , self.config.demandLowerLimit)) # parameters for the formula
            self.b_b = np.mean((self.config.demandUpperLimit , self.config.demandLowerLimit))*(np.mean((self.config.leadRecItemLow[self.agentNum] , 
            self.config.leadRecItemUp[self.agentNum])) + np.mean((self.config.leadRecOrderLow[self.agentNum] , self.config.leadRecOrderUp[self.agentNum]))) # parameters for the formula
        elif self.config.demandDistribution == 1 or self.config.demandDistribution == 3 or self.config.demandDistribution == 4:
            self.a_b = self.config.demandMu # parameters for the formula
            self.b_b = self.config.demandMu*(np.mean((self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit[self.agentNum] , 
            self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[self.agentNum])) + np.mean((self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit[self.agentNum] , self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit[self.agentNum]))) # parameters for the formula
        elif self.config.demandDistribution == 2:
            self.a_b = 8 # parameters for the formula
            self.b_b = (3/4.)*8*(np.mean((self.config.leadRecItemLow[self.agentNum] , 
            self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[self.agentNum])) + np.mean((self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit[self.agentNum] , self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit[self.agentNum]))) # parameters for the formula
        elif self.config.demandDistribution == 3:
            self.a_b = 10 # parameters for the formula
            self.b_b = 7*(np.mean((self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit[self.agentNum] , 
            self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[self.agentNum])) + np.mean((self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit[self.agentNum] , self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit[self.agentNum]))) # parameters for the formula
        self.rewardsOverTime = []
        self.costOverTime = [] 
        self.hist = []  # this is used for plotting - keeps the history for only one game
        self.hist2 = []	# this is used for animation usage
        self.srdqnBaseStock = [[] for item in range(self.config.noItems)]	# this holds the base stock levels that srdqn has came up with. added on Nov 8, 2017
        self.T = 0
        self.bsBaseStock = 0  
        self.init_bsBaseStock = 0 
        self.nextObservation = []
        print("Model type", self.compTypeTrain)
        if self.compTypeTrain == 'srdqn':
            print("Model type is sqrdn for player", agentNum)
            self.brain = QModel(self.agentNum,config)
            self.brain.setInitState(self.currentState) # sets the initial input of the network

    def resetPlayer(self, T):
        self.IL = self.ILInitial
        self.OO = [0 for i in range(self.config.noItems)]
        self.AS = [np.squeeze(np.zeros((1,T + max(self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit) + max(self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit) + 10 ))) for i in range(self.config.noItems)] 	# arrived shipment 
        self.AO = [np.squeeze(np.zeros((1,T + max(self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit) + max(self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit) + 10 )))	for i in range(self.config.noItems)]# arrived order	
        # print(self.AS)
        # if self.agentNum != 0:
        #     for i in range(self.config.leadRecOrderUp_aux[self.agentNum-1]):
        #         self.AO[i] = self.AOInitial[self.agentNum - 1]
        # for i in range(self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[self.agentNum]):
        #     self.AS[i] = self.ASInitial[i]
        # self.AS = self.ASInitial
        self.currentReward = 0 # the reward observed at the current step
        self.cumulativeReward = 0 # cumulative reward; reset at the begining of each episode	
        self.action= [[] for item in range(self.config.noItems)] 
        self.hist = []
        self.hist2 = []
        self.srdqnBaseStock = [[] for item in range(self.config.noItems)]	# this holds the base stock levels that srdqn has came up with. 
        self.T = T
        self.currentObservation = self.getCurState(1)  # this function gets the current state of the game
        self.nextObservation = []
        if self.compTypeTrain == 'srdqn':
            self.brain.setInitState(self.currentObservation) # sets the initial input of the network

    def receiveItems(self, time):
        self.IL = [ self.IL[itemIndex] + self.AS[itemIndex][time] for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)]# inverntory level update
        self.OO = [ self.OO[itemIndex] - self.AS[itemIndex][time] for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)] # invertory in transient update
    
    def receiveItemsRealtime(self, AS, itemIndex):
        self.IL[itemIndex] = self.IL[itemIndex] + AS[itemIndex]# inventory level update
        self.OO[itemIndex] = self.OO[itemIndex] - AS[itemIndex] # inventory in transient update

    def actionValue(self,curTime,playType, itemIndex):
        
        if playType == "test":
            if self.config.fixedAction:
                a=([ b[itemIndex][1] for b in self.config.actionList][np.argmax(self.action[itemIndex])])
            else:
                # "d + x" rule 
                if self.compTypeTest == 'srdqn':
                    a=(max(0, [ b[itemIndex][1] for b in self.config.actionList][np.argmax(self.action[itemIndex])]*self.config.action_step + self.AO[itemIndex][curTime]))
                elif self.compTypeTest == 'rnd':
                    a=(max(0, [ b[itemIndex][1] for b in self.config.actionList][np.argmax(self.action[itemIndex])] + self.AO[itemIndex][curTime]))
                else: 
                    a.append(max(0, self.config.actionListOpt[np.argmax(self.action[itemIndex])]))
                
        elif playType == "train":
            if self.config.fixedAction:
                a=(self.config.actionList[np.argmax(self.action[itemIndex])])
            else:
                if self.compTypeTrain == 'srdqn':
                    a=(max(0, [ b[itemIndex][1] for b in self.config.actionList][np.argmax(self.action[itemIndex])]*self.config.action_step + self.AO[itemIndex][curTime]))
                elif self.compTypeTest == 'rnd':
                    a=(max(0, [ b[itemIndex][1] for b in self.config.actionList][np.argmax(self.action[itemIndex])] + self.AO[itemIndex][curTime]))
                else: 
                    a=(max(0, [ b[itemIndex][1] for b in self.config.actionList][np.argmax(self.action[itemIndex])]))
            
        return a
        

    def getReward(self, curTime, demand):
        # cost (holding + backorder) for one time unit
        self.currentReward= sum([(self.shortageCost * max(0,-self.IL[itemIndex]) + self.holdingCost * max(0,self.IL[itemIndex]))/200. for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)]) # self.config.Ttest # 
        self.currentReward = -self.currentReward;		# make reward negative, because it is the cost
        # sum total reward of each agent
        self.rewardsOverTime.append(self.currentReward)

        cost = sum([sum([(self.shortageCost*self.IL[itemIndex]), (self.holdingCost*(self.AO[itemIndex][curTime] - demand[itemIndex]))]) for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)])
        self.costOverTime.append(cost)
        self.cumulativeReward = self.config.gamma*self.cumulativeReward + self.currentReward	

    def getRewardRealtime(self, curTime, demand, itemIndex, inventoryLevel, backOrders):
        def normalize(x, min_value, max_value):
            return (x - min_value) / (max_value - min_value)
        # cost (holding + backorder) for one time unit
        #make the reward based on the last cost ie. difference between the last cost and the current one
        _cost = (self.shortageCost * backOrders) + (self.holdingCost * inventoryLevel)
        
        if curTime == 0:
            costDiff = 0 - _cost
        else:
            costDiff = self.costArray[curTime-1][itemIndex] - _cost
        
        self.rewardArray[curTime].append(costDiff/200)
        # self.rewardArray.append(normalize(costDiff, self.config.demandLowerLimit, self.config.demandUpperLimit)) # self.config.Ttest # 
        self.costArray[curTime].append(_cost)
        if itemIndex == (self.config.noItems-1):
            self.currentReward = sum(self.rewardArray[curTime])
            self.currentReward = self.currentReward;		
            self.rewardsOverTime.append(self.currentReward)

            self.currentCost = sum(self.costArray[curTime])
            self.costOverTime.append(self.currentCost)
            self.cumulativeReward = self.config.gamma*self.cumulativeReward + self.currentReward	
            self.rewardArray.append([])
            self.costArray.append([])
            np.save(f"{self.config.model_dir}/cost.npz", self.costOverTime)
            np.save(f"{self.config.model_dir}/reward.npz", self.rewardsOverTime)
        
    def getCurState(self,t):
        stateDict = {}
        for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems):
            if self.config.ifUseASAO:
                if self.config.if_use_AS_t_plus_1:
                    stateDict[itemIndex]= np.array([-1*(self.IL[itemIndex]<0)*self.IL[itemIndex],1*(self.IL[itemIndex]>0)*self.IL[itemIndex],self.OO[itemIndex],self.AS[t],self.AO[t]])
                else:                   
                    stateDict[itemIndex]= np.array([-1*(self.IL[itemIndex]<0)*self.IL[itemIndex],1*(self.IL[itemIndex]>0)*self.IL[itemIndex],self.OO[itemIndex],self.AS[itemIndex][t-1],self.AO[itemIndex][t]])
            else:
                stateDict[itemIndex]= np.array([-1*(self.IL[itemIndex]<0)*self.IL[itemIndex],1*(self.IL[itemIndex]>0)*self.IL[itemIndex],self.OO[itemIndex]])

            if self.config.ifUseActionInD:
                a = self.config.actionList[np.argmax(self.action)]
                stateDict[itemIndex]= np.concatenate((stateDict[itemIndex], np.array([a])))
        currentState = stateDict
        return currentState

class BeerGame(object):
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.config = config
        self.curGame = 0 # The number associated with the current game (counter of the game)
        self.curTime = 0
        self.iterationsPlayed = 0  # total iterations of the game, played so far in this and previous games
        self.players = self.createAgent()  # create the agents 
        self.T = 0
        self.demand = []
        self.playType = []  # "train" or "test"
        self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist = self.config.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist
        self.getOptimalSol()
        self.totRew = 0    # it is reward of all players obtained for the current player.
        self.resultTest	= []
        self.runnerMidlResults = []		# stores the results to use in runner comparisons
        self.runnerFinlResults = []		# stores the results to use in runner comparisons
        self.middleTestResult = []		# stores the whole middle results of bs, Strm, and random to avoid doing same tests multiple of times.
        self.runNumber = 0		# the runNumber which is used when use runner
        self.strNum = 0			# the runNumber which is used when use runner	
        
    def createAgent(self):         	
        agentTypes = self.config.agentTypes 
        return [
            Agent(i,
                  [vars(self.config)[f'ILInit{i}_{itemIndex}'] for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)], 
                  [vars(self.config)[f'AOInit{i}_{itemIndex}'] for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)],  
                  [vars(self.config)[f'ASInit{i}_{itemIndex}'] for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)],
                  self.config.holdingCosts[i], 
                  self.config.shortageCosts[i], 
                  self.config.eta[i], 
                  agentTypes[i],self.config) 
            for i in range(self.config.NoAgent)]
        
    def getOptimalSol(self):
        # if self.config.NoAgent !=1:
        if self.config.NoAgent !=1 and 1 == 2:
            # check the Shang and Song (2003) condition.
            for k in range(self.config.NoAgent-1):
                if not (self.players[k].holdingCost == self.players[k+1].holdingCost and self.players[k+1].shortageCost == 0):
                    self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist = False
                
            # if the Shang and Song (2003) condition satisfied, it runs the algorithm
            if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist == True:
                calculations = np.zeros((7,self.config.NoAgent))
                for k in range(self.config.NoAgent):
                    # DL_high
                    calculations[0][k] = ((self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit +self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit + 2)/2 \
                                        + (self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit+self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit + 2)/2)* \
                                        (self.config.demandUpperLimit - self.config.demandLowerLimit - 1)
                    if k > 0:
                        calculations[0][k] += calculations[0][k-1]
                    # probability_high
                    nominator_holdingCost = 0
                    low_denominator_holdingCost = 0				
                    for j in range(k,self.config.NoAgent):
                        if j < self.config.NoAgent-1:
                            nominator_holdingCost += self.players[j+1].holdingCost
                        low_denominator_holdingCost += self.players[j].holdingCost 
                    if k == 0:
                        high_denominator_holdingCost = low_denominator_holdingCost
                    calculations[2][k] = (self.players[0].shortageCost + nominator_holdingCost)/(self.players[0].shortageCost + low_denominator_holdingCost + 0.0)
                    # probability_low
                    calculations[3][k] = (self.players[0].shortageCost + nominator_holdingCost)/(self.players[0].shortageCost + high_denominator_holdingCost + 0.0)
                # S_high
                calculations[4] = np.round(np.multiply(calculations[0],calculations[2]))
                # S_low
                calculations[5] = np.round(np.multiply(calculations[0],calculations[3]))
                # S_avg
                calculations[6] = np.round(np.mean(calculations[4:6], axis=0))
                # S', set the base stock values into each agent.
                for k in range(self.config.NoAgent):
                    if k == 0:
                        self.players[k].bsBaseStock = calculations[6][k]
                        
                    else:
                        self.players[k].bsBaseStock = calculations[6][k] - calculations[6][k-1]
                        if self.players[k].bsBaseStock < 0:
                            self.players[k].bsBaseStock = 0
        elif self.config.NoAgent ==1:				
            if self.config.demandDistribution==0:
                self.players[0].bsBaseStock = np.ceil(self.config.holdingCost[0]/(self.config.holdingCost[0]+self.config.shortageCost[0]+ 0.0))*((self.config.demandUpperLimit-self.config.demandLowerLimit-1)/2)*self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit
        elif 1 == 1:
            f = self.config.baseStockPolicy
            f_init = self.config.baseStockPolicy_init
            for k in range(self.config.NoAgent):
                self.players[k].bsBaseStock = f[k]
                self.players[k].int_bslBaseStock = f_init[k]
        
    def planHorizon(self):
        # TLow: minimum number for the planning horizon # TUp: maximum number for the planning horizon
        #output: The planning horizon which is chosen randomly.
        # return randint(self.config.TLow,self.config.TUp)
        return 99

    def resetGame(self, demand, playType):
        self.playType = playType  #"train" or "test"
        self.demand = demand
        self.curTime = 0
        if playType == "train":
            self.curGame += 1
            self.iterationsPlayed += self.T
            self.T = self.planHorizon()	
        else:
            self.T = self.config.Ttest	
            
        # reset the required information of player for each episode
        for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
            self.players[k].resetPlayer(self.T)

        # update OO when there are initial IL,AO,AS
        self.update_OO()
	
    def getTotRew(self):
        totRew = 0
        for i in range(self.config.NoAgent):
            # sum all rewards for the agents and make correction
            totRew += self.players[i].cumulativeReward

        for i in range(self.config.NoAgent):
            self.players[i].currentReward += self.players[i].eta*(totRew - self.players[i].cumulativeReward) #/(self.T)
	
    def distTotReward(self):
        totRew = 0
        optRew = 0.1
        for i in range(self.config.NoAgent):
            # sum all rewards for the agents and make correction
            totRew += self.players[i].cumulativeReward	
        totRew += optRew
        
        for i in range(self.config.NoAgent):
            for j in range(self.T):
                if self.config.NoAgent>1 and hasattr(self.players[i], 'brain') and (len(self.players[i].brain.replayMemory)>0):
                    #self.players[i].brain.replayMemory[-1*(j+1)][2] += (np.power(self.config.alpha,j)/(self.config.NoAgent-1))*((totRew - self.players[i].cumReward)/(self.T)) # changes the last T periods in the replayMemory
                    self.players[i].brain.replayMemory[-1*(j+1)][2] += (self.config.distCoeff/(self.config.NoAgent-1))*((totRew - self.players[i].cumulativeReward)/(self.T)) # changes the last T periods in the replayMemory					

    def getAction(self, k):
        # get action for training run
        if self.playType == "train":
            if  self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "srdqn":
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLen)
                self.players[k].action = self.players[k].brain.getDNNAction(self.playType)
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "Strm":
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLenOpt)
                self.players[k].action[np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)\
                                    -max(0,round(self.players[k].AO[self.curTime] +\
                                    self.players[k].alpha_b*(self.players[k].IL - self.players[k].a_b) +\
                                    self.players[k].betta_b*(self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].b_b)))))] = 1
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTest == "rnd":	
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLen)
                a = np.random.randint(self.config.actionListLen)
                self.players[k].action[a] = 1
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "bs":	
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLenOpt)
                if self.config.demandDistribution == 2:
                    if self.curTime   and self.config.use_initial_BS <= 4:
                        self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].int_bslBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
                    else: 
                        self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
                else:
                    self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
            else:
                # not a valid player is defined.
                raise Exception('The player type is not defined or it is not a valid type.!')

        # get action for test runs
        elif self.playType == "test":
            if  self.players[k].compTypeTest == "srdqn":
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLen)
                if self.config.ifPlaySavedData:
                    self.players[k].action[int(self.loaded_dqn_actions[self.curTime])] = 1
                else:
                    self.players[k].action = self.players[k].brain.getDNNAction(self.playType)
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTest == "Strm":
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLenOpt)

                self.players[k].action[np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,round(self.players[k].AO[self.curTime] +\
                                    self.players[k].alpha_p*(self.players[k].IL - self.players[k].a_b) +\
                                    self.players[k].beta_p*(self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].b_b)))))] = 1	
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTest == "rnd":	
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLen)
                a = np.random.randint(self.config.actionListLen)
                self.players[k].action[a] = 1
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTest == "bs":
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLenOpt)

                if self.config.demandDistribution == 2:
                    if self.curTime   and self.config.use_initial_BS <= 4:
                        self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].int_bslBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
                    else: 
                        self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
                else:
                    self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
            else:
                # not a valid player is defined.
                raise Exception('The player type is not defined or it is not a valid type.!')
                # print(self.curTime, self.players[k].agentNum, "IL", self.players[k].IL, "OO", self.players[k].OO, "Op", self.players[k].bsBaseStock, self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO))

    def next(self):
        # get a random leadtime		
        leadTimeIn = randint(self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit[self.config.NoAgent-1], self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[self.config.NoAgent-1]) 
        for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems):
            # handle the most upstream recieved shipment 		
            self.players[self.config.NoAgent-1].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime + leadTimeIn] += self.players[self.config.NoAgent-1].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex)

            for k in range(self.config.NoAgent-1,-1,-1): # [3,2,1,0]
                
                # get current IL and Backorder
                current_IL = max(0, self.players[k].IL[itemIndex])
                current_backorder = max(0, -self.players[k].IL[itemIndex])

                # TODO: We have get the AS and AO from the UI and update our AS and AO, so that code update the corresponding variables
                
                # increase IL and decrease OO based on the action, for the next period 
                self.players[k].receiveItems(self.curTime)
                
                # observe the reward
                possible_shipment = min(current_IL + self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime], current_backorder + self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime])
                
                # plan arrivals of the items to the downstream agent
                if self.players[k].agentNum > 0:
                    leadTimeIn = randint(self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit[k-1], self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[k-1])
                    self.players[k-1].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime + leadTimeIn] += possible_shipment

                # update IL
                self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] -= self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime]
                # observe the reward
                self.players[k].getReward(self.curTime, self.demand)
                
                self.players[k].hist[-1][-2] = self.players[k].currentReward
                self.players[k].hist2[-1][-2] = self.players[k].currentReward

                # update next observation 
                self.players[k].nextObservation = self.players[k].getCurState(self.curTime+1)
            
            if self.config.ifUseTotalReward:
                # correction on cost at time T
                if self.curTime == self.T:
                    self.getTotRew()					
            
        self.curTime +=1				

    def handleAction(self,):
        # get random lead time 
        leadTime = randint(self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit[0], self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit[0])
        for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems):
            # set AO 
            print("AO-------------")
            print(self.players[0].AO[itemIndex])
            self.players[0].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime] += self.demand[itemIndex][self.curTime]
            for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
                self.getAction(k)
                self.players[k].srdqnBaseStock[itemIndex] += self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex) + self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] +  self.players[k].OO[itemIndex]
                
                # update hist for the plots	
                self.players[k].hist += [[self.curTime,self.players[k].IL, self.players[k].OO,\
                            self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime,self.playType,itemIndex),self.players[k].currentReward, self.players[k].srdqnBaseStock[-1]]]

                if (self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "srdqn" and self.playType == "train") or (self.players[k].compTypeTest == "srdqn" and self.playType == "test"):
                    self.players[k].hist2 += [[self.curTime,self.players[k].IL[itemIndex], self.players[k].OO[itemIndex], self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime], self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime], \
                            self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime,self.playType,itemIndex), self.players[k].currentReward, \
                            self.config.actionList[np.argmax(self.players[k].action)]]]

                else:
                    self.players[k].hist2 += [[self.curTime,self.players[k].IL[itemIndex], self.players[k].OO[itemIndex], self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime], self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime], \
                            self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime,self.playType,itemIndex), self.players[k].currentReward, 0]]

                # updates OO and AO at time t+1
                
                self.players[k].OO[itemIndex] += self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex) # open order level update
                leadTime = randint(self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit[k], self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit[k])
                if self.players[k].agentNum < self.config.NoAgent-1:
                    self.players[k+1].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime + leadTime] += self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex) # open order level update


    def nextRealtime(self, currentDemand):
        # get a random leadtime		
        leadTimeIn = randint(self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit[self.config.NoAgent-1], self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[self.config.NoAgent-1]) 
        for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems):
            # handle the most upstream recieved shipment 		
            self.players[self.config.NoAgent-1].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime + leadTimeIn] += self.players[self.config.NoAgent-1].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex)

            for k in range(self.config.NoAgent-1,-1,-1): # [3,2,1,0]
                
                # get current IL and Backorder
                current_IL = max(0, self.players[k].IL[itemIndex])
                current_backorder = max(0, -self.players[k].IL[itemIndex])

                # TODO: We have get the AS and AO from the UI and update our AS and AO, so that code update the corresponding variables
                
                # increase IL and decrease OO based on the action, for the next period 
                self.players[k].receiveItems(self.curTime)
                
                # observe the reward
                possible_shipment = min(current_IL + self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime], current_backorder + self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime])
                
                # plan arrivals of the items to the downstream agent
                if self.players[k].agentNum > 0:
                    leadTimeIn = randint(self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit[k-1], self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[k-1])
                    self.players[k-1].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime + leadTimeIn] += possible_shipment

                # update IL
                self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] -= self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime]
                # observe the reward
                self.players[k].getReward(self.curTime, currentDemand)
                
                self.players[k].hist[-1][-2] = self.players[k].currentReward
                self.players[k].hist2[-1][-2] = self.players[k].currentReward

                # update next observation 
                self.players[k].nextObservation = self.players[k].getCurState(self.curTime+1)
            
            if self.config.ifUseTotalReward:
                # correction on cost at time T
                if self.curTime == self.T:
                    self.getTotRew()					
            
        self.curTime +=1				


    def handleActionRealtime(self,currentDemand):
        # get random lead time 
        leadTime = randint(self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit[0], self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit[0])
        for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems):
            # set AO 
            print("AO-------------")
            print(self.players[0].AO[itemIndex])
            print("Current Demand-------------")
            print(currentDemand)
            self.players[0].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime] += currentDemand[itemIndex]
            for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
                self.getAction(k)
                self.players[k].srdqnBaseStock[itemIndex] += self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex) + self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] +  self.players[k].OO[itemIndex]
                
                # update hist for the plots	
                self.players[k].hist += [[self.curTime,self.players[k].IL, self.players[k].OO,\
                            self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime,self.playType,itemIndex),self.players[k].currentReward, self.players[k].srdqnBaseStock[-1]]]

                if (self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "srdqn" and self.playType == "train") or (self.players[k].compTypeTest == "srdqn" and self.playType == "test"):
                    self.players[k].hist2 += [[self.curTime,self.players[k].IL[itemIndex], self.players[k].OO[itemIndex], self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime], self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime], \
                            self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime,self.playType,itemIndex), self.players[k].currentReward, \
                            self.config.actionList[np.argmax(self.players[k].action)]]]

                else:
                    self.players[k].hist2 += [[self.curTime,self.players[k].IL[itemIndex], self.players[k].OO[itemIndex], self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime], self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime], \
                            self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime,self.playType,itemIndex), self.players[k].currentReward, 0]]

                # updates OO and AO at time t+1
                
                self.players[k].OO[itemIndex] += self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex) # open order level update
                leadTime = randint(self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit[k], self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit[k])
                if self.players[k].agentNum < self.config.NoAgent-1:
                    self.players[k+1].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime + leadTime] += self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex) # open order level update

    # def playGameSingleIteration(self, demand, playType)
    def playGame(self, demand, playType):
        self.resetGame(demand, playType)

        # run the game
        print("Now currently waiting for demand....")
        while self.curTime <= self.T:
            # self.handleAction()
            # self.next()
            
            msg = consumer.poll(1.0)
            print("Now currently waiting for demand at time ", self.curTime)
            if msg is not None:
                if msg.error():
                    print("Consumer error: {}".format(msg.error()))

                try:
                    message = (json.loads(msg.value()))
                except Exception as e:
                    print(e)
                    continue
                # try:
                self.handleActionRealtime(message['demand'])
                self.nextRealtime(message['demand'])
                # except Exception as e:
                #     print(e)
                #     continue


                for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):					
                    if (self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "srdqn" and playType == "train") or (self.players[k].compTypeTest == "srdqn" and playType == "test"):
                        # control the learner agent 
                        self.players[k].brain.train(self.players[k].nextObservation,self.players[k].action, \
                                    self.players[k].currentReward,self.curTime == self.T,self.playType)
        if self.config.ifUsedistTotReward and playType == "train":
            self.distTotReward()
        for i in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
            print("History")
            print(self.players[i].rewardsOverTime)
            print(self.players[i].costOverTime)
            plt.plot(self.players[i].rewardsOverTime)
            plt.plot(self.players[i].costOverTime)
            plt.savefig(f"hist_{i}.png")
            plt.clf()
        return [-1*self.players[i].cumulativeReward for i in range(0,self.config.NoAgent)]
	
    def doTestMid(self, demandTs):
        if self.config.ifPlaySavedData:
            for c,i in enumerate(self.config.agentTypes):
                if i == "srdqn":
                    dnn_agent = c
                    break

        self.resultTest = []
        for i in range(self.config.testRepeatMid):
            if self.config.ifPlaySavedData:
                hist2 = np.load(os.path.join(self.config.model_dir,'DQN-0-player-'+str(dnn_agent)+'-'+str(i)+'.npy'))
                self.loaded_dqn_actions = hist2[:,7]
            self.doTest(i,demandTs[i])
        
        print("---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------")
        resultSummary = np.array(self.resultTest).mean(axis=0).tolist()	
        
        
        
        result_srdqn= ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, resultSummary[0])) 
        result_rand= ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, resultSummary[1])) 
        result_strm= ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, resultSummary[2])) 
        if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist:
            result_bs= ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, resultSummary[3])) 
            print('SUMMARY; {0:s}; ITER= {1:d}; SRDQN= [{2:s}]; SUM = {3:2.4f}; Rand= [{4:s}]; SUM = {5:2.4f}; STRM= [{6:s}]; SUM = {7:2.4f}; BS= [{8:s}]; SUM = {9:2.4f}'.format(
                strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime()) , 
                self.curGame, 
                result_srdqn, sum(resultSummary[0]), 
                result_rand, sum(resultSummary[1]),
                result_strm, sum(resultSummary[2]), 
                result_bs, sum(resultSummary[3])))	

        else:
            print('SUMMARY; {0:s}; ITER= {1:d}; SRDQN= [{2:s}]; SUM = {3:2.4f}; Rand= [{4:s}]; SUM = {5:2.4f}; STRM= [{6:s}]; SUM = {7:2.4f}'.format(strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime()) , 
                self.curGame, result_srdqn, sum(resultSummary[0]), 
                result_rand, sum(resultSummary[1]),
                result_strm, sum(resultSummary[2])))
        
        print("=======================================================================================")

    def doTest(self, m,demand):
        
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        
        if (self.config.ifSaveFigure) and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1])):
            plt.figure(self.curGame, figsize=(12, 8), dpi=80, facecolor='w', edgecolor='k')
        
        self.demand = demand
        # use dnn to get output.
        Rsltdnn,plt = self.tester(self.config.agentTypes ,plt, 'b', 'DQN' ,m)
        baseStockdata = self.players[0].srdqnBaseStock

        # check some condition to avoid doing same test middle again.
        if ((self.config.ifSaveFigure) and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1]))) \
            or (self.curGame >= self.config.maxEpisodesTrain-1) or (len(self.middleTestResult) < self.config.testRepeatMid):

            # use random to get output.
            RsltRnd ,plt= self.tester(["rnd","rnd","rnd","rnd"], plt,'y21', 'RAND' ,m)
                            
            # use formual to get output.
            RsltStrm ,plt= self.tester(["Strm","Strm","Strm","Strm"],plt, 'g', 'Strm' ,m)

            # use optimal strategy to get output, if it works.
            if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist:
                if self.config.agentTypes == ["srdqn", "Strm","Strm","Strm"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["bs","Strm","Strm","Strm"],plt, 'r', 'Strm-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["Strm", "srdqn","Strm","Strm"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["Strm","bs","Strm","Strm"],plt, 'r', 'Strm-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["Strm", "Strm","srdqn","Strm"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["Strm","Strm","bs","Strm"],plt, 'r', 'Strm-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["Strm", "Strm","Strm","srdqn"]:				 
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["Strm","Strm","Strm","bs"],plt, 'r', 'Strm-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["srdqn", "rnd","rnd","rnd"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["bs","rnd","rnd","rnd"],plt, 'r', 'RND-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["rnd", "srdqn","rnd","rnd"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["rnd","bs","rnd","rnd"],plt, 'r', 'RND-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["rnd", "rnd","srdqn","rnd"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["rnd","rnd","bs","rnd"],plt, 'r', 'RND-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["rnd", "rnd","rnd","srdqn"]:				 
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["rnd","rnd","rnd","bs"],plt, 'r', 'RND-BS' ,m)
                else:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["bs","bs","bs","bs"],plt, 'r', 'BS' ,m)			
            # hold the results of the optimal solution
                self.middleTestResult += [[RsltRnd,RsltStrm,Rsltbs]]
            else:
                self.middleTestResult += [[RsltRnd,RsltStrm]]
            
        else:
            # return the obtained results into their lists
            RsltRnd = self.middleTestResult[m][0]
            RsltStrm = self.middleTestResult[m][1]
            if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist:
                Rsltbs = self.middleTestResult[m][2]
            
        # save the figure
        if self.config.ifSaveFigure and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1])):
            savePlot(self.players, self.curGame, Rsltdnn  ,RsltStrm, Rsltbs , self.config, m)
                
        result_srdqn = ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, Rsltdnn)) 
        result_rand = ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, RsltRnd)) 
        result_strm = ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, RsltStrm)) 
        if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist:
            result_bs = ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, Rsltbs)) 
            print('output; {0:s}; Iter= {1:s}; SRDQN= [{2:s}]; sum = {3:2.4f}; Rand= [{4:s}]; sum = {5:2.4f}; Strm= [{6:s}]; sum = {7:2.4f}; BS= [{8:s}]; sum = {9:2.4f}'.format(
            strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime()) , str(str(self.curGame)+"-"+str(m)), result_srdqn , sum(Rsltdnn), 
            result_rand, sum(RsltRnd),
            result_strm, sum(RsltStrm), 
            result_bs, sum(Rsltbs)))	
            self.resultTest +=  [[Rsltdnn,RsltRnd,RsltStrm,Rsltbs]]

        else:
            print('output; {0:s}; Iter= {1:s}; SRDQN= [{2:s}]; sum = {3:2.4f}; Rand= [{4:s}]; sum = {5:2.4f}; Strm= [{6:s}]; sum = {7:2.4f}'.format(strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime()) , 
            str(str(self.curGame)+"-"+str(m)), result_srdqn, sum(Rsltdnn), 
            result_rand, sum(RsltRnd),
            result_strm, sum(RsltStrm)))	
            
            self.resultTest += [[Rsltdnn,RsltRnd,RsltStrm]]

        return sum(Rsltdnn)
	
    def tester(self,testType,plt, colori, labeli ,m):
		
        # set computation type for test
        for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
            self.players[k].compTypeTest = testType[k]
        # run the episode to get the results.
        result = self.playGame(self.demand,"test")
        # add the results into the figure
        if self.config.ifSaveFigure and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1])) and (testType[0] != "rnd"):
            plt = plotting(plt,[np.array(self.players[i].hist) for i in range(0,self.config.NoAgent)],colori, labeli)			
        if self.config.ifsaveHistInterval and ((self.curGame == 0) or (self.curGame == 1) or (self.curGame == 2) or(self.curGame == 3) or ((self.curGame - 1) % self.config.saveHistInterval == 0)\
            or ((self.curGame) % self.config.saveHistInterval == 0) or ((self.curGame) % self.config.saveHistInterval == 1) \
            or ((self.curGame) % self.config.saveHistInterval == 2)) :
            for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent): 
                name = labeli + "-" + str(self.curGame) + "-" + "player" + "-" + str(k)+ "-" + str(m)
                np.save(os.path.join(self.config.model_dir,name), np.array(self.players[k].hist2))

        # save the figure of base stocks
        if self.config.ifSaveFigure and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1])):
            for k in range(self.config.NoAgent):
                if self.players[k].compTypeTest == 'dnn':
                    plotBaseStock(self.players[k].srdqnBaseStock, 'b', 'base stock of agent '+ str(self.players[k].agentNum), self.curGame, self.config, m)

        return result,plt
		
    def update_OO(self):
        for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
            if k < self.config.NoAgent - 1:
                self.players[k].OO = sum(self.players[k+1].AO) + sum(self.players[k].AS)
            else:
                self.players[k].OO = sum(self.players[k].AS)

class BeerGame(object):
    def __init__(self, config):
        self.config = config
        self.curGame = 0 # The number associated with the current game (counter of the game)
        self.curTime = 0
        self.iterationsPlayed = 0  # total iterations of the game, played so far in this and previous games
        self.players = self.createAgent()  # create the agents 
        self.T = 0
        self.demand = []
        self.playType = []  # "train" or "test"
        self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist = self.config.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist
        self.getOptimalSol()
        self.totRew = 0    # it is reward of all players obtained for the current player.
        self.resultTest	= []
        self.runnerMidlResults = []		# stores the results to use in runner comparisons
        self.runnerFinlResults = []		# stores the results to use in runner comparisons
        self.middleTestResult = []		# stores the whole middle results of bs, Strm, and random to avoid doing same tests multiple of times.
        self.runNumber = 0		# the runNumber which is used when use runner
        self.strNum = 0			# the runNumber which is used when use runner	
        
    def createAgent(self):         	
        agentTypes = self.config.agentTypes 
        res =  [
            Agent(i,
                  [vars(self.config)[f'ILInit{i}_{itemIndex}'] for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)], 
                  [vars(self.config)[f'AOInit{i}_{itemIndex}'] for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)],  
                  [vars(self.config)[f'ASInit{i}_{itemIndex}'] for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems)],
                  self.config.holdingCosts[i], 
                  self.config.shortageCosts[i], 
                  self.config.eta[i], 
                  agentTypes[i],self.config) 
            for i in range(self.config.NoAgent)]
        print("Initial inventory level:")
        print(res[0].IL)
        return res
        
    def getOptimalSol(self):
        # if self.config.NoAgent !=1:
        if self.config.NoAgent !=1 and 1 == 2:
            # check the Shang and Song (2003) condition.
            for k in range(self.config.NoAgent-1):
                if not (self.players[k].holdingCost == self.players[k+1].holdingCost and self.players[k+1].shortageCost == 0):
                    self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist = False
                
            # if the Shang and Song (2003) condition satisfied, it runs the algorithm
            if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist == True:
                calculations = np.zeros((7,self.config.NoAgent))
                for k in range(self.config.NoAgent):
                    # DL_high
                    calculations[0][k] = ((self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit +self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit + 2)/2 \
                                        + (self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit+self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit + 2)/2)* \
                                        (self.config.demandUpperLimit - self.config.demandLowerLimit - 1)
                    if k > 0:
                        calculations[0][k] += calculations[0][k-1]
                    # probability_high
                    nominator_holdingCost = 0
                    low_denominator_holdingCost = 0				
                    for j in range(k,self.config.NoAgent):
                        if j < self.config.NoAgent-1:
                            nominator_holdingCost += self.players[j+1].holdingCost
                        low_denominator_holdingCost += self.players[j].holdingCost 
                    if k == 0:
                        high_denominator_holdingCost = low_denominator_holdingCost
                    calculations[2][k] = (self.players[0].shortageCost + nominator_holdingCost)/(self.players[0].shortageCost + low_denominator_holdingCost + 0.0)
                    # probability_low
                    calculations[3][k] = (self.players[0].shortageCost + nominator_holdingCost)/(self.players[0].shortageCost + high_denominator_holdingCost + 0.0)
                # S_high
                calculations[4] = np.round(np.multiply(calculations[0],calculations[2]))
                # S_low
                calculations[5] = np.round(np.multiply(calculations[0],calculations[3]))
                # S_avg
                calculations[6] = np.round(np.mean(calculations[4:6], axis=0))
                # S', set the base stock values into each agent.
                for k in range(self.config.NoAgent):
                    if k == 0:
                        self.players[k].bsBaseStock = calculations[6][k]
                        
                    else:
                        self.players[k].bsBaseStock = calculations[6][k] - calculations[6][k-1]
                        if self.players[k].bsBaseStock < 0:
                            self.players[k].bsBaseStock = 0
        elif self.config.NoAgent ==1:				
            if self.config.demandDistribution==0:
                self.players[0].bsBaseStock = np.ceil(self.config.holdingCost[0]/(self.config.holdingCost[0]+self.config.shortageCost[0]+ 0.0))*((self.config.demandUpperLimit-self.config.demandLowerLimit-1)/2)*self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit
        elif 1 == 1:
            f = self.config.baseStockPolicy
            f_init = self.config.baseStockPolicy_init
            for k in range(self.config.NoAgent):
                self.players[k].bsBaseStock = f[k]
                self.players[k].int_bslBaseStock = f_init[k]
        
    def planHorizon(self):
        # TLow: minimum number for the planning horizon # TUp: maximum number for the planning horizon
        #output: The planning horizon which is chosen randomly.
        # return randint(self.config.TLow,self.config.TUp)
        return 99

    def resetGame(self, demand, playType):
        self.playType = playType  #"train" or "test"
        # self.demand = demand
        self.curTime = 0
        if playType == "train":
            self.curGame += 1
            self.iterationsPlayed += self.T
            self.T = self.planHorizon()	
        else:
            self.T = self.config.Ttest	
            
        # reset the required information of player for each episode
        for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
            self.players[k].resetPlayer(self.T)

        # update OO when there are initial IL,AO,AS
        self.update_OO()

    def resetGameRealtime(self, playType):
        self.playType = playType  #"train" or "test"
        # self.demand = demand
        self.curTime = 0
        if playType == "train":
            self.curGame += 1
            self.iterationsPlayed += self.T
            self.T = self.planHorizon()	
        else:
            self.T = self.config.Ttest	
            
        # reset the required information of player for each episode
        for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
            self.players[k].resetPlayer(self.T)

        # update OO when there are initial IL,AO,AS
        self.update_OO()
	
    def getTotRew(self):
        totRew = 0
        for i in range(self.config.NoAgent):
            # sum all rewards for the agents and make correction
            totRew += self.players[i].cumulativeReward

        for i in range(self.config.NoAgent):
            self.players[i].currentReward += self.players[i].eta*(totRew - self.players[i].cumulativeReward) #/(self.T)
	
    def distTotReward(self):
        totRew = 0
        optRew = 0.1
        for i in range(self.config.NoAgent):
            # sum all rewards for the agents and make correction
            totRew += self.players[i].cumulativeReward	
        totRew += optRew
        
        for i in range(self.config.NoAgent):
            for j in range(self.T):
                if self.config.NoAgent>1 and hasattr(self.players[i], 'brain') and (len(self.players[i].brain.replayMemory)>0):
                    #self.players[i].brain.replayMemory[-1*(j+1)][2] += (np.power(self.config.alpha,j)/(self.config.NoAgent-1))*((totRew - self.players[i].cumReward)/(self.T)) # changes the last T periods in the replayMemory
                    self.players[i].brain.replayMemory[-1*(j+1)][2] += (self.config.distCoeff/(self.config.NoAgent-1))*((totRew - self.players[i].cumulativeReward)/(self.T)) # changes the last T periods in the replayMemory					

    def getAction(self, k):
        # get action for training run
        if self.playType == "train":
            if  self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "srdqn":
                print("This is the player type: ",self.players[k].compTypeTrain)
                _decisions = []
                for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems):
                     _actions = (np.zeros(self.config.actionListLen))
                     _actions = list(self.players[k].brain.getDNNAction(self.playType, itemIndex))
                     print("action list", [ i[itemIndex][1] for i in self.config.actionList ])
                     print("actions", _actions)
                     _decisions.append([ i[itemIndex][1] for i in self.config.actionList ][[int(i) for i in _actions].index(1)])
                _decisions = [ list(i) for i in enumerate(_decisions)]
                print("These are the decision: ", _decisions)
                for i in range(len(self.config.actionList)):
                    for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems):
                        self.config.actionList[i][itemIndex] = list(self.config.actionList[i][itemIndex])
                print("These is the actionList: ", self.config.actionList)
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLen)
                for i,j in enumerate([ list(i) for i in self.config.actionList ]):
                    print("string j", str(j))
                    print("string _decisions", str(_decisions))
                    if str(j) == str(_decisions):
                        self.players[k].action[i] = 1
                        break
                print("These are the actions for player k: ", self.players[k].action)
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "Strm":
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLenOpt)
                self.players[k].action[np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)\
                                    -max(0,round(self.players[k].AO[self.curTime] +\
                                    self.players[k].alpha_b*(self.players[k].IL - self.players[k].a_b) +\
                                    self.players[k].betta_b*(self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].b_b)))))] = 1
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTest == "rnd":	
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLen)
                a = np.random.randint(self.config.actionListLen)
                self.players[k].action[a] = 1
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "bs":	
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLenOpt)
                if self.config.demandDistribution == 2:
                    if self.curTime   and self.config.use_initial_BS <= 4:
                        self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].int_bslBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
                    else: 
                        self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
                else:
                    self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
            else:
                # not a valid player is defined.
                raise Exception('The player type is not defined or it is not a valid type.!')

        # get action for test runs
        elif self.playType == "test":
            if  self.players[k].compTypeTest == "srdqn":
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLen)
                if self.config.ifPlaySavedData:
                    self.players[k].action[int(self.loaded_dqn_actions[self.curTime])] = 1
                else:
                    self.players[k].action = self.players[k].brain.getDNNAction(self.playType)
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTest == "Strm":
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLenOpt)

                self.players[k].action[np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,round(self.players[k].AO[self.curTime] +\
                                    self.players[k].alpha_p*(self.players[k].IL - self.players[k].a_b) +\
                                    self.players[k].beta_p*(self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].b_b)))))] = 1	
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTest == "rnd":	
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLen)
                a = np.random.randint(self.config.actionListLen)
                self.players[k].action[a] = 1
            elif self.players[k].compTypeTest == "bs":
                self.players[k].action = np.zeros(self.config.actionListLenOpt)

                if self.config.demandDistribution == 2:
                    if self.curTime   and self.config.use_initial_BS <= 4:
                        self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].int_bslBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
                    else: 
                        self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
                else:
                    self.players[k].action [np.argmin(np.abs(np.array(self.config.actionListOpt)-\
                                max(0,(self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO - self.players[k].AO[self.curTime]))) ))] = 1	
            else:
                # not a valid player is defined.
                raise Exception('The player type is not defined or it is not a valid type.!')
                # print(self.curTime, self.players[k].agentNum, "IL", self.players[k].IL, "OO", self.players[k].OO, "Op", self.players[k].bsBaseStock, self.players[k].bsBaseStock - (self.players[k].IL + self.players[k].OO))
        print("This was the action decided on...")
        
        self.actionSuggestion = self.config.actionList[np.where(self.players[k].action == 1)]
        print(self.actionSuggestion)

    def nextRealtime(self, t_minus_1_orders, arrivingShipment):
        # get a random leadtime		
        leadTimeIn = randint(self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit[self.config.NoAgent-1], self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[self.config.NoAgent-1]) 
        t = self.curTime
        for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems):
            # handle the most upstream recieved shipment 		
            # self.players[self.config.NoAgent-1].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime + leadTimeIn] += self.players[self.config.NoAgent-1].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex)

            for k in range(self.config.NoAgent): 
                
                # get current IL and Backorder
                current_IL = max(0, (self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] - t_minus_1_orders[itemIndex]))
                if (self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] - t_minus_1_orders[itemIndex]) < 0:
                    current_backorder = abs(self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] - t_minus_1_orders[itemIndex])
                else:
                    current_backorder = 0

                # TODO: We have get the AS and AO from the UI and update our AS and AO, so that code update the corresponding variables
                
                # increase IL and decrease OO based on the action, for the next period 
                # self.players[k].receiveItemsRealtime(arrivingShipment, itemIndex)
                
                # observe the reward
                possible_shipment = arrivingShipment[itemIndex]
                
                # plan arrivals of the items to the downstream agent
                # if self.players[k].agentNum > 0:
                #     leadTimeIn = randint(self.config.leadRecItemLowerLimit[k-1], self.config.leadRecItemUpperLimit[k-1])
                #     self.players[k-1].AS[itemIndex][seslf.curTime + leadTimeIn] += possible_shipment
                if arrivingShipment is not None:
                    t  = self.curTime + 1
                self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][t] += arrivingShipment[itemIndex]

                # update IL
                print("The AS value................", self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime])
                print("The IL value................", self.players[k].IL[itemIndex])
                print("The orders value................", t_minus_1_orders[itemIndex])

                if arrivingShipment is not None:
                    self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] = max(0, (self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] - t_minus_1_orders[itemIndex]) + self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime])
                else:
                    self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] = max(0, (self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] - t_minus_1_orders[itemIndex]))
                
                # observe the reward
                self.players[k].getRewardRealtime(self.curTime, t_minus_1_orders, itemIndex, current_IL, current_backorder)
                print(f"Reward observed for {k}: ",self.players[k].currentReward)
                
        # self.players[k].hist[-1][-2] = self.players[k].currentReward
        # self.players[k].hist2[-1][-2] = self.players[k].currentReward

        self.players[k].nextObservation = self.players[k].getCurState(self.curTime)    
        if arrivingShipment is not None:
            self.curTime = t
        if self.config.ifUseTotalReward:
            # correction on cost at time T
            if self.curTime == self.T:
                self.getTotRew()
            
        				
            


    def handleActionRealtime(self,currentDemand):
        # get random lead time 
        leadTime = randint(self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit[0], self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit[0])
        for itemIndex in range(self.config.noItems):
            # set AO 
            self.players[0].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime] += currentDemand[itemIndex]	
            for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
                self.getAction(k)
                self.players[k].srdqnBaseStock[itemIndex] += self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex) + self.players[k].IL[itemIndex] +  self.players[k].OO[itemIndex]
                
                # update hist for the plots	
                self.players[k].hist += [[self.curTime,self.players[k].IL, self.players[k].OO,\
                            self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime,self.playType,itemIndex),self.players[k].currentReward, self.players[k].srdqnBaseStock[-1]]]

                if (self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "srdqn" and self.playType == "train") or (self.players[k].compTypeTest == "srdqn" and self.playType == "test"):
                    self.players[k].hist2 += [[self.curTime,self.players[k].IL[itemIndex], self.players[k].OO[itemIndex], self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime], self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime], \
                            self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime,self.playType,itemIndex), self.players[k].currentReward, \
                            self.config.actionList[np.argmax(self.players[k].action)]]]

                else:
                    self.players[k].hist2 += [[self.curTime,self.players[k].IL[itemIndex], self.players[k].OO[itemIndex], self.players[k].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime], self.players[k].AS[itemIndex][self.curTime], \
                            self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime,self.playType,itemIndex), self.players[k].currentReward, 0]]

                # updates OO and AO at time t+1
                
                self.players[k].OO[itemIndex] += self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex) # open order level update
                leadTime = randint(self.config.leadRecOrderLowerLimit[k], self.config.leadRecOrderUpperLimit[k])
                if self.players[k].agentNum < self.config.NoAgent-1:
                    self.players[k+1].AO[itemIndex][self.curTime + leadTime] += self.players[k].actionValue(self.curTime, self.playType,itemIndex) # open order level update

    # def playGameSingleIteration(self, demand, playType)
    def playGame(self, playType):
        self.resetGameRealtime(playType)

        # run the game
        print("Now currently waiting for demand....")
        while self.curTime <= self.T:
            # self.handleAction()
            # self.next()
            msg = consumer.poll(1.0)
            if msg is not None:
                if msg.error():
                    print("Consumer error: {}".format(msg.error()))
                try:
                    message = (json.loads(msg.value()))
                except Exception as e:
                    print(e)
                    continue
                # try:
                self.handleActionRealtime(message['arriving_orders'])
                self.nextRealtime(message['arriving_orders'], message['arriving_shipment'])
                # except Exception as e:
                #     print(e)
                #     continue


                for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):					
                    if (self.players[k].compTypeTrain == "srdqn" and playType == "train") or (self.players[k].compTypeTest == "srdqn" and playType == "test"):
                        # control the learner agent 
                        self.players[k].brain.train(self.players[k].nextObservation,self.players[k].action, \
                                    self.players[k].currentReward,self.curTime == self.T,self.playType)
                print(self.actionSuggestion)
                sendData({"orders":[i[1] for i in self.actionSuggestion[0]]},"robodine")
                logging.info(f"Current time: {self.curTime}")
        if self.config.ifUsedistTotReward and playType == "train":
            self.distTotReward()
        for i in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
            print("History")
            print(self.players[i].rewardsOverTime)
            print(self.players[i].costOverTime)
            plt.plot(self.players[i].rewardsOverTime)
            plt.plot(self.players[i].costOverTime)
            plt.savefig(f"hist_{i}.png")
            plt.clf()
        return [-1*self.players[i].cumulativeReward for i in range(0,self.config.NoAgent)]
	
    def doTestMid(self, demandTs):
        if self.config.ifPlaySavedData:
            for c,i in enumerate(self.config.agentTypes):
                if i == "srdqn":
                    dnn_agent = c
                    break

        self.resultTest = []
        for i in range(self.config.testRepeatMid):
            if self.config.ifPlaySavedData:
                hist2 = np.load(os.path.join(self.config.model_dir,'DQN-0-player-'+str(dnn_agent)+'-'+str(i)+'.npy'))
                self.loaded_dqn_actions = hist2[:,7]
            self.doTest(i,demandTs[i])
        
        print("---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------")
        resultSummary = np.array(self.resultTest).mean(axis=0).tolist()	
        
        
        
        result_srdqn= ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, resultSummary[0])) 
        result_rand= ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, resultSummary[1])) 
        result_strm= ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, resultSummary[2])) 
        if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist:
            result_bs= ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, resultSummary[3])) 
            print('SUMMARY; {0:s}; ITER= {1:d}; SRDQN= [{2:s}]; SUM = {3:2.4f}; Rand= [{4:s}]; SUM = {5:2.4f}; STRM= [{6:s}]; SUM = {7:2.4f}; BS= [{8:s}]; SUM = {9:2.4f}'.format(
                strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime()) , 
                self.curGame, 
                result_srdqn, sum(resultSummary[0]), 
                result_rand, sum(resultSummary[1]),
                result_strm, sum(resultSummary[2]), 
                result_bs, sum(resultSummary[3])))	

        else:
            print('SUMMARY; {0:s}; ITER= {1:d}; SRDQN= [{2:s}]; SUM = {3:2.4f}; Rand= [{4:s}]; SUM = {5:2.4f}; STRM= [{6:s}]; SUM = {7:2.4f}'.format(strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime()) , 
                self.curGame, result_srdqn, sum(resultSummary[0]), 
                result_rand, sum(resultSummary[1]),
                result_strm, sum(resultSummary[2])))
        
        print("=======================================================================================")

    def doTest(self, m,demand):
        
        import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
        
        if (self.config.ifSaveFigure) and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1])):
            plt.figure(self.curGame, figsize=(12, 8), dpi=80, facecolor='w', edgecolor='k')
        
        self.demand = demand
        # use dnn to get output.
        Rsltdnn,plt = self.tester(self.config.agentTypes ,plt, 'b', 'DQN' ,m)
        baseStockdata = self.players[0].srdqnBaseStock

        # check some condition to avoid doing same test middle again.
        if ((self.config.ifSaveFigure) and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1]))) \
            or (self.curGame >= self.config.maxEpisodesTrain-1) or (len(self.middleTestResult) < self.config.testRepeatMid):

            # use random to get output.
            RsltRnd ,plt= self.tester(["rnd","rnd","rnd","rnd"], plt,'y21', 'RAND' ,m)
                            
            # use formual to get output.
            RsltStrm ,plt= self.tester(["Strm","Strm","Strm","Strm"],plt, 'g', 'Strm' ,m)

            # use optimal strategy to get output, if it works.
            if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist:
                if self.config.agentTypes == ["srdqn", "Strm","Strm","Strm"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["bs","Strm","Strm","Strm"],plt, 'r', 'Strm-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["Strm", "srdqn","Strm","Strm"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["Strm","bs","Strm","Strm"],plt, 'r', 'Strm-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["Strm", "Strm","srdqn","Strm"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["Strm","Strm","bs","Strm"],plt, 'r', 'Strm-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["Strm", "Strm","Strm","srdqn"]:				 
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["Strm","Strm","Strm","bs"],plt, 'r', 'Strm-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["srdqn", "rnd","rnd","rnd"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["bs","rnd","rnd","rnd"],plt, 'r', 'RND-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["rnd", "srdqn","rnd","rnd"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["rnd","bs","rnd","rnd"],plt, 'r', 'RND-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["rnd", "rnd","srdqn","rnd"]:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["rnd","rnd","bs","rnd"],plt, 'r', 'RND-BS' ,m)
                elif self.config.agentTypes == ["rnd", "rnd","rnd","srdqn"]:				 
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["rnd","rnd","rnd","bs"],plt, 'r', 'RND-BS' ,m)
                else:
                    Rsltbs ,plt= self.tester(["bs","bs","bs","bs"],plt, 'r', 'BS' ,m)			
            # hold the results of the optimal solution
                self.middleTestResult += [[RsltRnd,RsltStrm,Rsltbs]]
            else:
                self.middleTestResult += [[RsltRnd,RsltStrm]]
            
        else:
            # return the obtained results into their lists
            RsltRnd = self.middleTestResult[m][0]
            RsltStrm = self.middleTestResult[m][1]
            if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist:
                Rsltbs = self.middleTestResult[m][2]
            
        # save the figure
        if self.config.ifSaveFigure and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1])):
            savePlot(self.players, self.curGame, Rsltdnn  ,RsltStrm, Rsltbs , self.config, m)
                
        result_srdqn = ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, Rsltdnn)) 
        result_rand = ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, RsltRnd)) 
        result_strm = ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, RsltStrm)) 
        if self.ifOptimalBaseStockPolicyExist:
            result_bs = ', '.join(map("{:.2f}".format, Rsltbs)) 
            print('output; {0:s}; Iter= {1:s}; SRDQN= [{2:s}]; sum = {3:2.4f}; Rand= [{4:s}]; sum = {5:2.4f}; Strm= [{6:s}]; sum = {7:2.4f}; BS= [{8:s}]; sum = {9:2.4f}'.format(
            strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime()) , str(str(self.curGame)+"-"+str(m)), result_srdqn , sum(Rsltdnn), 
            result_rand, sum(RsltRnd),
            result_strm, sum(RsltStrm), 
            result_bs, sum(Rsltbs)))	
            self.resultTest +=  [[Rsltdnn,RsltRnd,RsltStrm,Rsltbs]]

        else:
            print('output; {0:s}; Iter= {1:s}; SRDQN= [{2:s}]; sum = {3:2.4f}; Rand= [{4:s}]; sum = {5:2.4f}; Strm= [{6:s}]; sum = {7:2.4f}'.format(strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", gmtime()) , 
            str(str(self.curGame)+"-"+str(m)), result_srdqn, sum(Rsltdnn), 
            result_rand, sum(RsltRnd),
            result_strm, sum(RsltStrm)))	
            
            self.resultTest += [[Rsltdnn,RsltRnd,RsltStrm]]

        return sum(Rsltdnn)
	
    def tester(self,testType,plt, colori, labeli ,m):
		
        # set computation type for test
        for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
            self.players[k].compTypeTest = testType[k]
        # run the episode to get the results.
        result = self.playGame(self.demand,"test")
        # add the results into the figure
        if self.config.ifSaveFigure and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1])) and (testType[0] != "rnd"):
            plt = plotting(plt,[np.array(self.players[i].hist) for i in range(0,self.config.NoAgent)],colori, labeli)			
        if self.config.ifsaveHistInterval and ((self.curGame == 0) or (self.curGame == 1) or (self.curGame == 2) or(self.curGame == 3) or ((self.curGame - 1) % self.config.saveHistInterval == 0)\
            or ((self.curGame) % self.config.saveHistInterval == 0) or ((self.curGame) % self.config.saveHistInterval == 1) \
            or ((self.curGame) % self.config.saveHistInterval == 2)) :
            for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent): 
                name = labeli + "-" + str(self.curGame) + "-" + "player" + "-" + str(k)+ "-" + str(m)
                np.save(os.path.join(self.config.model_dir,name), np.array(self.players[k].hist2))

        # save the figure of base stocks
        if self.config.ifSaveFigure and (self.curGame in range(self.config.saveFigInt[0],self.config.saveFigInt[1])):
            for k in range(self.config.NoAgent):
                if self.players[k].compTypeTest == 'dnn':
                    plotBaseStock(self.players[k].srdqnBaseStock, 'b', 'base stock of agent '+ str(self.players[k].agentNum), self.curGame, self.config, m)

        return result,plt
		
    def update_OO(self):
        for k in range(0,self.config.NoAgent):
            if k < self.config.NoAgent - 1:
                self.players[k].OO = sum(self.players[k+1].AO) + sum(self.players[k].AS)
            else:
                self.players[k].OO = sum(self.players[k].AS)
